rubrics.justification: The response over-interprets a single static image, inferring partial collapse, asymmetric blastocoel, dense ICM location, and TE quality that are not clearly discernible. It also treats the image as supporting a detailed 3AA assessment despite limited visible structure.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor context, endometrial thickness, and cycle history reasonably well with embryo prognosis, though some links are speculative and overstated.

The structure is logical, but the probability adjustment framework relies on unsupported numeric penalties and speculative morphology-based deductions, creating some inconsistency between reported high embryo grade and downgraded prognosis.

Much of the counseling is broadly consistent with IVF practice, but recommendations such as assisted hatching for this case, ERA after limited failure history, thrombophilia screening, and borderline PGT-A indication at age 33 are not strongly guideline-based.

The response gives clear practical next steps for transfer counseling, lifestyle modification, and contingency planning, though several suggested investigations/interventions may be more aggressive than necessary.
